item.case_name: Two people in four seasons, 20 s, 16:9, text only
item.title: Two people, four seasons

turns.text:
Make a 20-second 16:9 short film in four seasons with two people. There are no reference images.

Mara: a woman in her thirties with short curly red hair, round gold glasses and a mustard-yellow wool coat.
Theo: a tall man in his sixties with a white beard, a navy flat cap and a long grey scarf.
Keep each of them looking the same every time they appear.

Four shots of 5 seconds each, in this order:
1. Spring: Mara stands under a cherry tree in blossom, looks at the camera and holds out a hand as pink petals fall.
2. Summer: Theo walks barefoot along a bright beach at the edge of the waves.
3. Autumn: Theo sits on a park bench among red and orange leaves and catches a falling leaf.
4. Winter: Mara stands in falling snow, smiles at the camera and waves goodbye.

No text on screen, no sound. Give me one finished video file.

item.tests: Tests two described people who must stay the same between clips; one comes back after two clips of the other.

answer_sheet.People: Mara and Theo as described; the same every time.
answer_sheet.Shots: Spring Mara, summer Theo, autumn Theo, winter Mara, 5 seconds each.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 20-second 16:9 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, in order, each once
Mara, Theo, Theo, Mara: the right person in each season
Mara is the same person in spring and winter
Theo is the same person in summer and autumn
No season is left in the next season's frames
